bio.text: Gary Palmer grew up in Hackleburg, Alabama, and represents Alabama's 6th Congressional District; he was elected to the 114th Congress in 2014.
He earned a B.S. in Operations Management from the University of Alabama, where he was a walk-on member of the football team.
Before Congress he was President of the Alabama Policy Institute for 24 years, an organization that grew out of the Alabama Family Alliance he started.
He serves on the House Oversight and Energy and Commerce committees.
